reuse.why: Takes its category set from the shared getMonthWideCategories and writes through setBudget/getSheetValue/batchMessages, as the other month-wide actions do.

duplication.why: Repeats only the per-action income/tracking skip and sign flip that every existing month-wide action already writes inline; no larger block is copied.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside setZero and the averages, and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the action, its registration and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with the sibling actions; the inline income-skip and sign rule continue an existing repeated pattern rather than a shared helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthWideCategories rather than its own category query.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` skip and sign flip mirror the existing actions openly.
